subject: VPN won't connect for anyone
body: We're all working remotely today and nobody can get onto the VPN. It just says connection failed after signing in. Same result after restarting. All our job files and the processing system are only available through it, so the whole company is unable to process any work. We don't have another way into those systems.

can someone check the remote connection please? Everyone in the company is getting kicked off the VPN every 10–15 minutes today. We're all remote and use it for the shared systems. It reconnects after a couple of tries so we are getting jobs through, but we keep having to reopen things and repeat entries that didn't save.

subject: Whole office offline
body: Nothing on the office network is reachable this morning. Nobody on either floor can open the order system, shared drives or websites. Wired desks are the same as Wi-Fi. We can't process any orders at this site, and there's no working backup connection. The network printers have disappeared too, if that helps.
topic: site network (Wi-Fi, DNS, printers on the network)

subject: Office network very slow again
body: The whole office is seeing pages sit blank for ages before loading, and documents take several attempts to open from the shared drive. Happens on cables as well as wireless. Everyone can eventually get their jobs done, but each lookup is taking a minute or two instead of seconds. Started just after lunch.
topic: site network (Wi-Fi, DNS, printers on the network)

subject: Staff Wi-Fi missing
body: The staff wireless network has vanished across the site, not just in one room. Everyone here normally uses it. We've got all staff connected through desk docks and spare network cables for now, and the office is working normally that way. Please restore Wi-Fi though; we've had to move people out of the meeting rooms to cable them in.
topic: site network (Wi-Fi, DNS, printers on the network)

subject: SharePoint job library unavailable
body: Our company-wide SharePoint job library won't open for anyone. Teams links to the same files fail too. Every team needs those files to carry out and approve jobs, and none are available offline. We've checked across departments and nobody can proceed with today's jobs. Please investigate urgently.

subject: Teams chat not sending
body: Teams messages are stuck sending for everybody in the organisation. Looks like nothing has arrived since this morning. We've told all staff to use Outlook email and calendar invitations instead, and that's working, so coordination and meetings are continuing. Can you check Teams before we end up with two copies of every conversation when it comes back?

subject: Everyone stuck at company sign-in
body: The company sign-in keeps returning us to the login screen after MFA. Nobody can get into any of our work applications, including people who were already signed in and have now been thrown out. All departments are reporting the same thing. There are no separate logins we can use, so work across the organisation has stopped.

subject: Sign-in taking several attempts
body: Everyone at the site is having to approve MFA two or three times before the company login finally lets them in. Sometimes it says the request expired even though we approved straight away. We can still access the applications after retrying, but switching between them starts it again. It's adding a lot of waiting to everyone's work.

subject: Shared scheduling service won't save
body: The online staff scheduling service is rejecting every update across the organisation. All staff use it to pick up and record their daily assignments. We've switched everyone to the exported schedule in a shared spreadsheet, with changes recorded there, so assignments are still being covered. Please check the service settings or subscription; we'll need to reconcile the spreadsheet once saving works again.

subject: Internal work portal painfully slow
body: Since the certificate change, the internal work portal takes about a minute to open each page. Might be unrelated, but that's when it started. Everyone at this site uses it throughout the day and the whole office is seeing the delay. Pages do eventually load and submissions succeed, so we're still processing work, just much more slowly. No certificate warning showing.
topic: web and TLS (expired certificates, internal sites)

subject: All site laptops stuck after managed update
body: This morning's required device update has left every laptop at the site on a screen saying installation must finish before sign-in. It hasn't moved for over an hour. Nobody can reach their desktop or run the work applications. These are our only work devices, with no spare machines or browser access elsewhere, so the entire site is stopped. Please check the deployment.
